license_note: The repository ships the OpenMDW License Agreement 1.1 file, and the card and trial endpoint both name it as the governing instrument. It imposes no use restrictions beyond notice and litigation termination clauses but is not OSI-approved, so the record classifies it as open source consistent with the taxonomy classification of the instrument.
